function.arguments: {"observation": "`patient_id` has 48 duplicate values, meaning that some patients appear in more than one row. According to the data dictionary, `sample_seq` indicates assay run number, and a patient who was re-tested appears twice. The row with the highest `sample_seq` supersedes earlier rows for that patient.", "implication": "The population 'all enrolled patients' must be defined as one row per patient, so we must deduplicate on `patient_id`, keeping the row with the highest `sample_seq`. Failure to do so would count re-tested patients twice, biasing any patient-level fraction."}
function.name: note_finding
